turnout.notes: South Dakota turnout rows use the official Election Returns and Registration Figures county table. The denominator is 624,175 active voters as of November 5, 2024, and the 436,478 ballots-cast total exactly matches ElectionID 684 calcVoterTurnout across all 66 counties. EAC total-registration rows remain fallback provenance only.

historicalBaselines.warning: South Dakota historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential results from the 2012, 2016, and 2020 Secretary of State canvass and returns PDFs. The 2012 Shannon County source row is normalized to current Oglala Lakota County identity. Use these rows as historical context, not as evidence of 2024 precinct boundaries.

reviewCharts.sourceCoverage: Complete ElectionID 684 ENR universe: 691 county-qualified StatePrecinctID units across all 66 counties.
reviewCharts.warning: South Dakota review rows use complete official-source ElectionID 684 precinct/reporting-unit President-versus-at-large-U.S.-House data, but the Secretary of State application labels them unofficial. Their totals are 194 President votes and 184 U.S. House votes below the certified canvass; certified-minus-ENR county deltas are not allocated locally. The 59 C-prefixed administrative units are review context only, and no precinct geometry is loaded. These advisory rows are not findings of fraud or misconduct.
